description.en: Initializes the technique/skill-script ("waza") cutscene system, before setting up its participant characters/avatars with the CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_* commands and playing it with CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Start setting up a technique cutscene
CMND_INIT_SKILL_SCRIPT();
